AssetDescription.description_en: The business knowledge content of the column
AssetDescription.example: 用于唯一标识一笔订单。

AssetModifiedGmt.description_en: The last modification time of the business knowledge, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
AssetModifiedGmt.description_zh: 业务知识的最近修改时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

AutoIncrement.description_en:
Specifies whether the column is auto-incremented. Valid values:
true: The column is auto-incremented.
false: The column is not auto-incremented
AutoIncrement.description_zh: 字段是否自动递增。true 表示自动递增，false 表示不自动递增

ColumnId.description_en: The ID of the column in DMS

ColumnKeyType.description_en:
The key type of the column. Valid values:
PRIMARY: Primary key.
UNIQUE: Unique key.
INDEX: Index column.
FOREIGN: Foreign key.
If the column has multiple key attributes, the value is returned based on the preceding priority order
ColumnKeyType.description_zh: 字段的键类型。PRIMARY：主键；UNIQUE：唯一键；INDEX：索引字段；FOREIGN：外键。字段同时具有多种键属性时，按上述顺序优先返回

ColumnType.description_en: The data type of the column, including the length or precision of the type
ColumnType.description_zh: 字段的数据类型，包括类型自身的长度或精度信息

Description.description_en: The column comment in the table creation statement
Description.description_zh: 建表语句中的字段注释

HotLevel.description_en: The knowledge popularity level. A value of 0 indicates no popularity score. Values from 1 to 5 indicate popularity levels from low to high
HotLevel.description_zh: 知识热度等级。0 表示尚无热度评分，1～5 表示由低到高的热度等级

Level.description_en: The knowledge level. This level is used to distinguish the generation, confirmation, and lock statuses of the knowledge. A value greater than 3 indicates the locked status
Level.description_zh: 知识等级。用于区分知识的生成、确认及锁定状态；大于 3 时对应锁定状态

LevelType.description_en:
The knowledge status. Valid values:
to_completed: Pending completion.
to_verify: Pending verification.
verified: Verified.
verify_failed: Verification failed.
is_delete: Deleted.
unlocked: Unlocked.
locked: Locked
LevelType.description_zh: 知识状态。to_completed：待补充；to_verify：待认证；verified：已认证；verify_failed：认证失败；is_delete：已删除；unlocked：未锁定；locked：已锁定

Nullable.description_en:
Specifies whether the column allows null values. Valid values:
true: Null values are allowed.
false: Null values are not allowed
Nullable.description_zh: 字段是否允许为空。true 表示允许，false 表示不允许

Plain.description_en:
Specifies whether the current user has plaintext access permissions for the column. Valid values:
true: Plaintext access is allowed.
false: Plaintext access is not allowed
Plain.description_zh: 当前用户是否具有该字段的明文访问权限。true 表示可访问明文，false 表示不可访问明文

Position.description_en: The ordinal position of the column in the table definition
Position.description_zh: 字段在表定义中的排列顺序

SecurityLevel.description_en:
The security level of the column. Valid values:
UNKNOWN: Unknown.
INNER: Internal.
SENSITIVE: Sensitive.
CONFIDENTIAL: Confidential
SecurityLevel.description_zh: 字段的安全级别。UNKNOWN：未知；INNER：内部；SENSITIVE：敏感；CONFIDENTIAL：机密

TableId.description_en: The ID of the table in DMS

Title.description_en: The Chinese business name of the column

UserSensitivityLevel.description_en: The sensitivity level identifier of the column configured by the tenant
UserSensitivityLevel.description_zh: 租户配置的字段敏感等级标识

description_en: Retrieves the details for each column in a table, including metadata, business descriptions, and security level
description_zh: 查询表的字段知识列表，包含字段元信息、业务描述、安全信息等
name: GetTableColumnList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: db_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
Success.title_en:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
Success.title_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
